text:
maria_cs: Heads up — customer Thalesys (finance) requested a short demo boost next Wed/Thu, needs EU + LATAM capacity and an allowlist header.
maria_cs: They emailed details (sensitive) — will paste header when AE confirms.
jamal_support: How big a bump? IPs rotating or static?
maria_cs: They expect ~250 qps sustained, 350 peak, for ~4h windows each day. They prefer header pin (rotate IPs).
devon_eng: We can do header allowlist + soft QPS bump. Recommend routing to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1 for best latency.
karen_oncall: Note renewal risk: AE says procurement is slow. Recommend canary + autorevert and monitoring.
maria_cs: AE asked if we can keep bump up to 72h if demo goes well.
jamal_support: Draft config to apply:

```
POST /v1/customer-overrides
{
  "customer":"thalesys",
  "scope":"route",
  "regions":["eu-west-1","sa-east-1"],
  "allowlist": {"type":"header","header_name":"x-thalesys-demo","value":"demo-2026"},
  "rate_override": {"qps":350,"burst":600},
  "duration":"72h",
  "autorevert": true
}
```

jamal_support: Plan: stage canary at 10% for 10m, validate, then rollout to 100%.
devon_eng: Infra ok. Two ops notes: 1) pre-warm KV cache for the demo route, I'll run warmup job 30m before start. 2) pin model to v2-small for deterministic latency.
karen_oncall: I'll add alerts: >1% 5xx or p50 >200ms on demo route; page on breach. Also include rollback playbook.
maria_cs: Please add those steps to the runbook. AE will provide prompts for warmup.
jamal_support: Applying header allowlist to staging canary now.
deploy-bot: change-request 1768011234: applying route override for thalesys to staging (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 1768011248: staging canary healthy after 10m rollout. No errors.
jamal_support: Rolling to prod 100% and scheduling autorevert at 72h. TTL for allowlist set to 7d for post-demo debugging.
deploy-bot: change-success 1768011302: prod override applied to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. QA checks passed.
maria_cs: Great work, team. AE asked to capture this in renewal brief — demonstrates fast ops support.
karen_oncall: Runbook link added: https://playbooks.internal/demo-thalesys-runbook
maria_cs: I'll confirm header value and add DoS safeguards with Thalesys (rate ceilings per session).
jamal_support: Created ticket CS-1428 with config details and timestamps.
maria_cs: I'll follow up with AE and close this thread once demo outcome is known. :thumbsup:
